title: Annotatio V §.V: Salvation in knowledge of Truth so that Jesus must be loved — cannot be loved in broken Synaxis
pass_a_gloss: Thus placing salvation in the Knowledge of Truth, so that he teaches Jesus must be loved — who cannot be deeply loved in a Synaxis of Union [that is ruptured].
pass_b_english: On that reading, salvation sits in knowing the Truth, and that knowledge teaches us to love Jesus.
Where the synaxis of union is already torn, that love cannot go deep.
source_text: Ita ponens in Cognitione Veritatis salutem, ut amandum Jesum doceat, qui in Synaxi Unionis non potest adamari.
notes: Salus in Cognitio Veritatis; Synaxis Unionis.
